subject: Service continuity, remediation plan and commercial path forward
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@finova.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finova Procurement <procurement@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Recent latency spikes — impact to go-live window

Avery —

Hope you’re well. We’ve been seeing a recurring set of latency spikes in the last two weeks that have started to impact our scheduled go-live for the Payments Assist feature. Spike pattern: higher 95th/99th latency during evening US peak (approx 19:00–22:00 ET) and occasional token timeouts on multi-turn flows. Our SREs captured the attached summary (uptime-report-q3.csv).

This is putting our business timeline at risk. We need to understand:
- What immediate mitigations can Redwood apply to stabilize latency?
- Do you have an escalation/exception path for customers in our renewal window?
- If this is a capacity/architecture limit, what commercial routes exist to guarantee throughput (dedicated pods, premium tiers, SLA adjustments)?

We’re entering renewal conversations in two weeks; I need a clear remediation and commercial path to present to our execs and procurement. Can we schedule a short call today or tomorrow?

Thanks,
Linda Park
Director, Product Ops — Finova

Attachment: uptime-report-q3.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recent latency spikes — impact to go-live window

Linda —

Thanks for the data and flagging this. I’m sorry you’re seeing these spikes. We take this seriously and will prioritize. Immediate next steps I’m proposing:

1) Mitigation (today–48h) — I’ll have our runtime team enable tighter batching windows and temporarily pin your traffic to lower concurrency lanes to reduce tail latency. This is low-risk but may affect throughput; we’ll monitor.
2) Investigation (48h) — engineering will surface root-cause (KV cache churn vs. burst concurrency) and share findings.
3) Commercial path — if stabilization requires capacity guarantees, we can propose a time-bound Dedicated pilot (reserved pool) and an amended SLA for your renewal.

I’ve looped Marissa (our commercial lead) to outline options and get legal/finance involved as needed. Can you do a 30-minute call at 3pm ET today? If not, tomorrow morning ET works too.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0126

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Recent latency spikes — commercial proposal options (internal)

Internal note —

Summary of options to present to Finova:

A) Short-term concession (customer-first): 3 months of "service continuity credits" tied to availability/latency SLAs (credit formula based on token spend during incident windows). Offer requires: root-cause report within 10 business days and a remediation plan.

B) Technical path: Launch a 90-day Dedicated pilot (reserved GPU pool) with a 99.9% p95 latency SLO, pre-empt priority routing during peak window. Pilot pricing: add-on to hosted spend with a 20% uplift over current committed rate; we can provide a 10% introductory discount if they sign within their renewal window.

C) Long-term: If pilot confirms, propose migration to Dedicated with SLA uplift and an operational runbook (attached).

Ask: Recommend we lead with A+B — immediate credit to de-escalate procurement + Dedicated pilot offer as the commercial path. I’ve attached the proposed runbook and a clean SOW template to accelerate.

Attachments: service-runbook.pdf, SOW-template.docx (internal drafts)

Marissa
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

***CONFIDENTIAL (internal)*** — Please keep commercial concession guidance internal until we confirm Finova’s acceptance.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Recent latency spikes — commercial proposal options (internal)

Thanks Marissa — I agree on A+B to head-off escalation. A few constraints from finance/legal:

- Credits: cap at 3 months equivalent of average monthly token spend; require explicit incident windows and verification before payout.
- Pilot discount: approve up to 10% introductory discount but only if customer commits to an initial 6-month reserved minimum after pilot.
- SLA language: we’ll need a limited-duration amendment (90 days) rather than changing enterprise-wide SLA. Markus, can legal draft a short amendment and a DocuSign envelope?

I’ll draft the amendment language and share redlines by EOD. Also recommend we include a technical checkpoint at day 30 to evaluate whether to expedite migration.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recent latency spikes — impact to go-live window

Linda —

Thanks again for the report and for taking the call yesterday. Quick summary and path forward we’re proposing for Finova:

1) Immediate mitigation applied (Oct 20–22): tighter batching and priority routing during your evening peak. Monitoring shows a 45–60% reduction in 95th/99th latency spikes in our staging checks.

2) Root-cause & runbook (delivery by Oct 30): engineering will deliver a short RCA and the attached operational runbook that documents the checkpoint cadence and escalation flow.

3) Commercial remediation: as a gesture while we stabilize, we’ll apply up to three months of service continuity credits (capped at your average monthly token spend) tied to verified incident windows.

4) Dedicated pilot offer: 90-day pilot on a reserved pool with a 99.9% p95 latency SLO. Pilot pricing: 20% uplift to current committed spend with a 10% sign-within-renewal discount if you commit to a 6-month reserved minimum post-pilot.

If this approach is acceptable, I’ve attached a short amendment/SOW and created a DocuSign envelope to execute. Link: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0A1B2C3D.

Please let me know by COB Friday so we can get procurement and legal moving. Happy to jump on a call with your SREs and our runtime team to walk the runbook.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments: SOW-service-continuity-amendment.pdf
